name: Two-storey modern house (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Two-storey modern family house, 11.6 x 8 m: brick-slip ground floor, white render above, a dark slate gable roof with three solar panels, aluminium windows with precast sills, an open timber porch with a standing-seam lean-to roof. Enterable: living room, entrance hall and kitchen below, two bedrooms and a bathroom above, two internal stairs off a rear landing corridor.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
